result.downsampling: lap-distance bins retain representative values plus speed range, minimum throttle, peak brake, and peak absolute steering

steering.label: Steering wheel angle — ratio not recorded
steering.definition: Recorded SteeringWheelAngle. Without the car's steering ratio it cannot be converted to road-wheel angle, so it is never compared with road-wheel steering.

tire_stress.definition: bounded blend of brake fraction at speed, steering magnitude at speed, and lateral acceleration; it is not per-lap tread wear
